research_question: After blocking annotation inconsistencies, can compositional multilingual response-form and arousal cues make the M34 longitudinal system select, realize, verify, and revise the expected branch on new source-disjoint counterfactual pairs while preserving the M35 same-model baseline and cost controls?
single_core_variable: M36 adds bounded compositional multilingual cue normalization and target-guarded correction linkage; it does not change the base model, longitudinal information intervention, persona contract, memory authority, or final visible Japanese guard.

conditions.baseline: qwen3.5:9b receives current-turn visible dialogue and the shared public-Uruha expression contract but no seed history, verified branch, prediction, verification, or revision
conditions.system: the same qwen3.5:9b realizes the authoritative branch computed from the M36-remediated M34 typed longitudinal path

annotation_integrity_gate.contradiction_rule: every contradicted row must contain exactly one independently classified explicit replacement policy, match expected_feedback_policy, differ from expected_current_policy, and be scored
annotation_integrity_gate.support_uncertain_rule: feedback policy is not comparatively scored and expected_feedback_policy must be not_scored or null

reserve.post_seal_rule: do not edit reserve wording, labels, or scoring after validator pass; exposed M35 rows are development regressions only

controlled_variables: byte-identical current utterance within each pair and across conditions
same public-Uruha expression and natural-Japanese-visible contract
same output token budget and local machine
paired real prompt-token difference at most two tokens
same typed longitudinal packet shape and policy guide as M35

scored_outputs.mechanism_current: M34 selected policy before language realization
scored_outputs.mechanism_feedback_outcome: support, contradiction, or uncertainty linkage to the previous prediction
scored_outputs.current_surface: policy-specific observable Japanese surface act, reported separately from policy selection
scored_outputs.feedback_surface: only six validator-approved contradicted rows; visible correction/replacement act reported separately
scored_outputs.pair_test: baseline should remain invariant for byte-identical current input while system should diverge under verified response-form history
scored_outputs.annotation_integrity: validator pass rate and zero label-consistency errors

required_development_regressions: M35 English practical-help seed now creates verified solve reuse
M35 Japanese bounded-adverb arousal cue now activates the verified branch
sentence-initial English No and Japanese 違う do not contradict a pending branch without one valid explicit replacement policy
English give-me-one-modified-step and hear-me-out-no-advice corrections link and revise
M34 protected routes, raw-free persistence, persona, and natural-Japanese visible output do not regress
claim_boundary: a pass supports only source-disjoint controlled proxy evidence that the compositional longitudinal mechanism is more reliable than the current-turn-only condition on this reserve; it does not establish private-intent truth, human felt-understanding preference, general LLM superiority, or a human-brain equation
post_result_rule: do not modify M36 runtime, evaluator, prompts, reserve, protocol, thresholds, or labels from M36 reserve outcomes; failures move to a new milestone
